name: @tmi/api
description: Cloudflare Worker API + static host for the TMI tutor management portal

scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Refusing: the orgsupport branch deploys only to tutoring / tutoring-test. The institute (tmi-portal) and the demo (tmi-portal-test) ship from main.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.db:rebuild:remote: node -e "console.error('Refusing: the orgsupport branch deploys only to tutoring / tutoring-test. The institute (tmi-portal) and the demo (tmi-portal-test) ship from main.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:rebuild && npm run db:seed && npm run db:platform-admin
scripts.db:studio: wrangler d1 execute tmi-portal-db --local --command="SELECT u.id, u.email, u.full_name, m.organization_id, m.status, u.last_login_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN org_members m ON m.user_id = u.id ORDER BY u.full_name"
